answer_1.quote: we use models that were trained in an online fashion up until that point to generate next paragraph given the previous paragraphs as context that can fit into the length limitation of the model.

answer_2.quote: We assess the quality of the generated paragraphs using: ROUGE-1,2,L for lexical overlap with the reference paragraph, AlignScore for factual consistency based on a unified alignment function between the reference and generated text and UniEval , a multi-dimensional metric that evaluates coherence and fluency of the generated paragraph with respect to the context.
